company_name: Zhejiang Changxin Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.

summary: Zhejiang Changxin Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in thermoelectric Peltier pellets and modules, providing solutions for precise temperature control. Their products are designed for applications requiring efficient thermal management, such as medical and industrial systems.
